body:
The ends does not justify the means. Did Ghandi kill people? Martin Luther 
King? Ted destroyed his credibility even though much of what he says makes 
sense and should be studied. Killing people was not only morally wrong, it 
was counter-productive. There are better ways of getting a message out.

In article <d5GdnXRwxLK-A8KjXTWc3g@bravo.net>, nospam@nospam.com says...
>
>"Michael Haggerty" wrote in message ...
>>I take it you support Ted's actions in killing people, men with children that 
>>now mourn them.
>
>"In order to get our message before the public with some chance of
>making a lasting impression, we've had to kill people."
>-- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 96
>
>
